profile.name: Anirudh Sharma
profile.headline_pre: Android apps that feel alive in
profile.bio: I'm **Anirudh Sharma**, a mobile engineer in Bengaluru with 4+ years across consumer, POS, and Android TV apps, now Senior Software Engineer at Origin Fresh. Kotlin-first, Compose-native — happiest wiring up WebSockets, offline-first sync, and CI/CD pipelines that ship themselves.
profile.contact_blurb: Open to senior Android and mobile roles, plus freelance builds — consumer apps, Android TV, React Native, or full-stack with a Node.js backend. Email is the fastest route; I reply within a day.

projects.title: Shipped & in the wild
projects.sub: Production apps on Google Play — from fresh-produce marketplaces to TV discovery to open source.

experience.title: Where I've built
experience.sub: Four-plus years across product startups, agency work, and freelance builds.

skills.title: The toolkit
skills.sub: Deep on the modern Android stack, with full-stack range when a backend is needed.

projects.title: Wholesale Mandi
projects.description: Fresh-produce ordering app serving customers across Bengaluru and Chennai, rated 4.1 from nearly 7K reviews. I develop and ship it alongside the Origin Fresh app: MVVM with strict Dagger-Hilt DI, a modular XML → Jetpack Compose migration, and Firebase Remote Config flags for A/B-tested rollouts without waiting on app-store updates.

projects.title: Origin Fresh
projects.description: Consumer app for fresh fruits and veggies, with an in-app AI recipe generator on Google Gemini: enter what's in your kitchen, get a recipe. Payments run on Razorpay with webhook-driven confirmation for reliable order status.

projects.title: TLDR by LumioLabs
projects.description: Content discovery across movies, shows, music, and live sports from multiple platforms. I built real-time Android TV features in Compose over Socket.IO for 10K+ concurrent users, and a phone-to-TV launch flow over FCM.

projects.title: Dossier
projects.description: Two headline features for a self-hosted AI job-search app: a Claude connector that searches jobs, scores postings against your profile, and saves tailored drafts while keeping contact details private; and Startups discovery that ranks YC and Hacker News hiring posts while honoring robots.txt.

projects.title: EHO-Partner
projects.description: Emergency-services dispatch app with live location on Google Maps, real-time broadcasts over WebSockets, and Razorpay payments. Offline-first sync on Room and WorkManager keeps data safe through cellular dropouts.

experiences.summary: Consumer and POS Android apps for a fresh-produce business — Bengaluru.
points: Ship Wholesale Mandi (100K+ downloads, 4.1★) and Origin Fresh (10K+, 4.4★) on Google Play for customers across Bengaluru and Chennai
Own mobile architecture across consumer and POS apps with MVVM and strict Dagger-Hilt dependency injection
Led the modular XML → Jetpack Compose migration, speeding up feature delivery by 35% on a consistent design system
Built an AI recipe generator with Google Gemini APIs inside the Origin Fresh app
Integrated Razorpay with webhook-driven payment confirmation for reliable order and payment status
Runtime feature flags and A/B tests on Firebase Remote Config, cutting app-store update cycles for critical rollouts

experiences.summary: Real-time content discovery across phone and Android TV.
points: Built and shipped TLDR by LumioLabs (50K+ downloads), unifying movies, shows, music, and live sports with cross-platform search
Real-time Android TV features in Compose over bidirectional Socket.IO for 10,000+ concurrent users
Phone-to-TV launch flow over FCM, so users start content on the TV straight from their phone
GitHub Actions CI/CD that cut manual build and deploy time to staging and production by 50%
Eliminated a critical multi-threading race condition with Coroutines/Flow-driven state management

experiences.summary: Android plus the backend behind it — remote, end to end.
points: Designed Node.js + MongoDB backend services, consumed in-app via Retrofit and Coroutines
Firebase Authentication, FCM, and Analytics for security and user retention
Set UI regression test plans with Product, Design, and QA for zero-defect production releases

experiences.summary: First taste of large, multi-module Android at scale.
points: Memory-leak isolation, performance tuning, and refactoring across multi-module codebases, improving cold-start times
Moved high-traffic user flows from legacy views to Jetpack Compose, simplifying state management
